cards.question: あ
cards.explanation: Vowel 'a' as in 'father'. Looks like someone saying 'Ahhh' with arms out.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'a' como em 'pai'. Parece alguém dizendo 'Ahhh' de braços abertos.

cards.question: い
cards.explanation: Vowel 'i' as in 'see'. Two lines like chopsticks - 'ee'ting!
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'i' como em 'vi'. Duas linhas como hashis.

cards.question: う
cards.explanation: Vowel 'u' as in 'flute'. Looks like a face in profile saying 'oo'.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'u' como em 'uva'. Parece um rosto de perfil dizendo 'uu'.

cards.question: え
cards.explanation: Vowel 'e' as in 'pet'. Looks like an exotic bird.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'e' como em 'pé'. Parece um pássaro exótico.

cards.question: お
cards.explanation: Vowel 'o' as in 'boat'. Looks like a golfer about to swing - 'Oh!'
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'o' como em 'ovo'. Parece um jogador de golfe prestes a dar uma tacada - 'Oh!'

cards.question: か
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a sword cutting - 'ka-slash!'
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece uma espada cortando - 'ka-slash!'

cards.question: き
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a key - 'ki' sounds like 'key'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece uma chave - 'ki' soa como 'key' (chave em inglês).

cards.question: く
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a cuckoo bird's beak.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece o bico de um pássaro cuco.

cards.question: け
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a crooked keg on its side.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece um barril torto de lado.

cards.question: こ
cards.explanation: K-row. Two horizontal lines like a comb.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Duas linhas horizontais como um pente.

cards.question: さ
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a saddle on a horse.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece uma sela de cavalo.

cards.question: し
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a fishhook - 'shi' like 'she caught a fish'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece um anzol de pesca.

cards.question: す
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a swing set.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece um balanço.

cards.question: せ
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a mouth saying something.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece uma boca dizendo algo.

cards.question: そ
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a sewing needle with thread.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece uma agulha de costura com linha.

cards.question: た
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like 'ta-ta' waving goodbye.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece alguém dando tchau.

cards.question: ち
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a cheerleader doing a split.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece uma líder de torcida fazendo um espacate.

cards.question: つ
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a tsunami wave curling.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece uma onda de tsunami se curvando.

cards.question: て
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a telephone pole.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece um poste de telefone.

cards.question: と
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a toe stubbing against something.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece um dedo do pé (toe) batendo em algo.

cards.question: な
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like a knot tied in rope.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece um nó amarrado em uma corda.

cards.question: に
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like a knee bending.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece um joelho (knee) dobrando.

cards.question: ぬ
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like noodles being slurped.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece macarrão (noodles) sendo saboreado.

cards.question: ね
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like a cat sleeping - cats say 'ne' in Japanese.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece um gato dormindo - gatos dizem 'ne' em japonês.

cards.question: の
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like a 'NO' sign - a circle with a line.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece um sinal de 'NÃO' - um círculo riscado.

cards.question: は
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like 'ha ha' laughing person.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece uma pessoa rindo 'ha ha'.

cards.question: ひ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like a smiling face saying 'hee hee'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece um rosto sorridente dizendo 'hee hee'.

cards.question: ふ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like Mt. Fuji. Pronounced between 'fu' and 'hu'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece o Monte Fuji. Pronúncia entre 'fu' e 'hu'.

cards.question: へ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like a mountain peak - simple diagonal.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece o cume de uma montanha - diagonal simples.

cards.question: ほ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like a person hopping with arms up.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece uma pessoa pulando com os braços para cima.

cards.question: ま
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like a mama with a baby in arms.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece uma mãe (mama) com um bebê nos braços.

cards.question: み
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like the number 21 - 'me' in Japanese.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece o número 21.

cards.question: む
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like a cow saying 'moo'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece uma vaca dizendo 'muuu'.

cards.question: め
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like an eye - 'me' means 'eye'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece um olho - 'me' significa 'olho' em japonês.

cards.question: も
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like a fishing hook catching more fish.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece um anzol pescando mais (more) peixes.

cards.question: や
cards.explanation: Y-row. Looks like a yak from the side.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha Y. Parece um iaque de lado.

cards.question: ゆ
cards.explanation: Y-row. Looks like a U-turn sign - 'you' turn around.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha Y. Parece um sinal de retorno - 'u-turn'.

cards.question: よ
cards.explanation: Y-row. Looks like a yo-yo on a string.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha Y. Parece um ioiô em uma corda.

cards.question: ら
cards.explanation: R-row. Sounds between 'ra' and 'la'. Looks like a rabbit.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Som entre 'ra' e 'la'. Parece um coelho (rabbit).

cards.question: り
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like reeds bending in wind.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece juncos balançando ao vento.

cards.question: る
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like a loop - 'ru' like 'loop'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece um laço (loop).

cards.question: れ
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like a person reaching out.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece uma pessoa estendendo a mão.

cards.question: ろ
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like a road curving ahead.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece uma estrada (road) fazendo uma curva.

cards.question: わ
cards.explanation: W-row. Looks like a person waving.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha W. Parece uma pessoa acenando (waving).

cards.question: を
cards.explanation: Particle only. Used for object marker. Like 'wa' with extra stroke.
cards.explanation_pt: Apenas partícula. Usada como marcador de objeto. Como 'wa' com um traço extra.

cards.question: ん
cards.explanation: Standalone consonant. Looks like letter 'n' cursive.
cards.explanation_pt: Consoante isolada. Parece a letra 'n' cursiva.

cards.question: が
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ka'. Add dakuten (゛) to か. Used in 'ga' particle.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ka'. Adicione dakuten (゛) a か. Usada na partícula 'ga'.

cards.question: ぎ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ki'. Add dakuten to き.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ki'. Adicione dakuten a き.

cards.question: ぐ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ku'. Add dakuten to く.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ku'. Adicione dakuten a く.

cards.question: げ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ke'. Add dakuten to け.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ke'. Adicione dakuten a け.

cards.question: ご
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ko'. Add dakuten to こ. Example: ご飯 (gohan) = rice.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ko'. Adicione dakuten a こ. Ex: ご飯 (gohan) = arroz.

cards.question: ざ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'sa'. Add dakuten to さ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'sa'. Adicione dakuten a さ.

cards.question: じ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'shi'. Add dakuten to し. Common in 時間 (jikan) = time.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'shi'. Adicione dakuten a し. Comum em 時間 (jikan) = tempo.

cards.question: ず
cards.explanation: Voiced 'su'. Add dakuten to す.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'su'. Adicione dakuten a す.

cards.question: ぜ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'se'. Add dakuten to せ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'se'. Adicione dakuten a せ.

cards.question: ぞ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'so'. Add dakuten to そ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'so'. Adicione dakuten a そ.

cards.question: だ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ta'. Add dakuten to た. Common in だから (dakara) = therefore.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ta'. Adicione dakuten a た. Comum em だから (dakara) = portanto.

cards.question: ぢ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'chi'. Rarely used - じ is preferred for 'ji' sound.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'chi'. Raramente usada - じ é preferida para o som 'ji'.

cards.question: づ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'tsu'. Rarely used - ず is preferred for 'zu' sound.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'tsu'. Raramente usada - ず é preferida para o som 'zu'.

cards.question: で
cards.explanation: Voiced 'te'. Add dakuten to て. Particle meaning 'at/by'.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'te'. Adicione dakuten a て. Partícula que significa 'em/por'.

cards.question: ど
cards.explanation: Voiced 'to'. Add dakuten to と. Example: どこ (doko) = where.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'to'. Adicione dakuten a と. Ex: どこ (doko) = onde.

cards.question: ば
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ha'. Add dakuten to は.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ha'. Adicione dakuten a は.

cards.question: び
cards.explanation: Voiced 'hi'. Add dakuten to ひ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'hi'. Adicione dakuten a ひ.

cards.question: ぶ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'fu'. Add dakuten to ふ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'fu'. Adicione dakuten a ふ.

cards.question: べ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'he'. Add dakuten to へ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'he'. Adicione dakuten a へ.

cards.question: ぼ
cards.explanation: Voiced 'ho'. Add dakuten to ほ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão sonora de 'ho'. Adicione dakuten a ほ.

cards.question: ぱ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced 'ha'. Add handakuten (゜) to は.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão meio-sonora de 'ha'. Adicione handakuten (゜) a は.

cards.question: ぴ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced 'hi'. Add handakuten to ひ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão meio-sonora de 'hi'. Adicione handakuten a ひ.

cards.question: ぷ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced 'fu'. Add handakuten to ふ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão meio-sonora de 'fu'. Adicione handakuten a ふ.

cards.question: ぺ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced 'he'. Add handakuten to へ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão meio-sonora de 'he'. Adicione handakuten a へ.

cards.question: ぽ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced 'ho'. Add handakuten to ほ.
cards.explanation_pt: Versão meio-sonora de 'ho'. Adicione handakuten a ほ.

cards.question: きゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: き + small や. Glides into 'ya' sound.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: き + や pequeno. Desliza para o som 'ya'.

cards.question: きゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: き + small ゆ. Sounds cute - like 'cute' in Japanese!
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: き + ゆ pequeno. Soa fofo!

cards.question: きょ
cards.explanation: Combo: き + small よ. Common in 今日 (kyou) = today.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: き + よ pequeno. Comum em 今日 (kyou) = hoje.

cards.question: しゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: し + small や. Common in 写真 (shashin) = photo.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: し + や pequeno. Comum em 写真 (shashin) = foto.

cards.question: しゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: し + small ゆ. Common in 主人 (shujin) = husband.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: し + ゆ pequeno. Comum em 主人 (shujin) = marido.

cards.question: しょ
cards.explanation: Combo: し + small よ. Common in 少し (sukoshi) = a little.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: し + よ pequeno. Comum em 少し (sukoshi) = um pouco.

cards.question: ちゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: ち + small や. Like 'cha' in 'chai tea'.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: ち + や pequeno. Como o 'cha' de 'cha-cha-cha'.

cards.question: ちゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: ち + small ゆ. Sound of a kiss in Japanese!
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: ち + ゆ pequeno. Som de um beijo em japonês!

cards.question: ちょ
cards.explanation: Combo: ち + small よ. Common in ちょっと (chotto) = a little.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: ち + よ pequeno. Comum em ちょっと (chotto) = um pouco.

cards.question: にゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: に + small や. Cat sound in Japanese - にゃあ!
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: に + や pequeno. Som de gato em japonês - nyaa!

cards.question: にゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: に + small ゆ. Common in ニュース (nyuusu) = news.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: に + ゆ pequeno. Comum em ニュース (nyuusu) = notícias.

cards.question: にょ
cards.explanation: Combo: に + small よ. Less common combination.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: に + よ pequeno. Combinação menos comum.

cards.question: ひゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: ひ + small や. Like 'hya' in exclamation.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: ひ + や pequeno. Como 'hya' em exclamações.

cards.question: ひゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: ひ + small ゆ. Sound of wind - 'hyuuu'.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: ひ + ゆ pequeno. Som do vento - 'hyuuu'.

cards.question: ひょ
cards.explanation: Combo: ひ + small よ. Common in 表 (hyou) = chart.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: ひ + よ pequeno. Comum em 表 (hyou) = gráfico.

cards.question: みゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: み + small や. Rare combination.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: み + や pequeno. Combinação rara.

cards.question: みゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: み + small ゆ. Used in music (ミュージック).
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: み + ゆ pequeno. Usado em música.

cards.question: みょ
cards.explanation: Combo: み + small よ. Common in 名字 (myouji) = surname.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: み + よ pequeno. Comum em 名字 (myouji) = sobrenome.

cards.question: りゃ
cards.explanation: Combo: り + small や. Less common.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: り + や pequeno. Menos comum.

cards.question: りゅ
cards.explanation: Combo: り + small ゆ. Common in 竜 (ryuu) = dragon!
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: り + ゆ pequeno. Comum em 竜 (ryuu) = dragão!

cards.question: りょ
cards.explanation: Combo: り + small よ. Common in 旅行 (ryokou) = travel.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo: り + よ pequeno. Comum em 旅行 (ryokou) = viagem.

cards.question: ぎゃ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: ぎ + small や.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: ぎ + や pequeno.

cards.question: ぎゅ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: ぎ + small ゆ. Common in 牛 (gyuu) = cow.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: ぎ + ゆ pequeno. Comum em 牛 (gyuu) = vaca.

cards.question: ぎょ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: ぎ + small よ. Common in 魚 (gyo) = fish.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: ぎ + よ pequeno. Comum em 魚 (gyo) = peixe.

cards.question: じゃ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: じ + small や. Common in じゃあ = well then.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: じ + や pequeno. Comum em じゃあ = bem então.

cards.question: じゅ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: じ + small ゆ. Common in 十 (juu) = ten.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: じ + ゆ pequeno. Comum em 十 (juu) = dez.

cards.question: じょ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: じ + small よ. Common in 女性 (josei) = woman.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: じ + よ pequeno. Comum em 女性 (josei) = mulher.

cards.question: びゃ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: び + small や. Rare combination.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: び + や pequeno. Combinação rara.

cards.question: びゅ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: び + small ゆ. Rare - used in ビュー (view).
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: び + ゆ pequeno. Raro - usado em view (vista).

cards.question: びょ
cards.explanation: Voiced combo: び + small よ. Common in 病院 (byouin) = hospital.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo sonoro: び + よ pequeno. Comum em 病院 (byouin) = hospital.

cards.question: ぴゃ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced combo: ぴ + small や. Very rare.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo meio-sonoro: ぴ + や pequeno. Muito raro.

cards.question: ぴゅ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced combo: ぴ + small ゆ. Onomatopoeia for whistling.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo meio-sonoro: ぴ + ゆ pequeno. Onomatopeia para assobio.

cards.question: ぴょ
cards.explanation: Half-voiced combo: ぴ + small よ. Onomatopoeia for hopping.
cards.explanation_pt: Combo meio-sonoro: ぴ + よ pequeno. Onomatopeia para pular.
